title: Full-Spectrum Review Finding
description: Machine-readable form of the canonical finding header owned by references/finding-protocol.md. Markdown reports remain the canonical artifact; this schema validates JSON exports and tooling around them, never the prose body.

id.description: Stable repository-level identity. Never renumbered, never reused.

confidence.description: Evidence strength for the mechanism/conclusion. Independent from priority.

status.description: Lifecycle status. Status changes never delete the ID.

type.description: One primary type. Secondary dimensions go in area tags, not new types.

area.description: Subsystem, flow, or boundary the finding belongs to.

evidence.description: Concrete pointers: path:line, test, contract, history, measurement.

blocking.description: Only when meaningful. Never filled with a placeholder.

domain-pack.description: Pack name and version, e.g. trading@4.

blast.description: Real exposure the impact was stated against. Optional; never filled with a placeholder.

frequency.description: Whether the trigger frequency rests on field evidence or code-path analysis. Optional.
